name: Business Insurance Live Transfers

hero.headline: Business Insurance Live Transfers
hero.subheadline: Connect with high-intent consumers actively looking for business insurance solutions.

overview: Business Insurance Live Transfers are consumers qualified by our team and warm-transferred to your agents, generated by Altarious Global performance campaigns and delivered to your business in real time. Connect small business owners and self-employed professionals buying their first or replacement business coverage with licensed agents.

Live Transfers help agencies focus producers on accounts that fit their small business appetite. Our team confirms the state, business type, employee count, revenue range and the coverages the owner is seeking before warm-transferring the call. This screening filters out excluded classes and larger accounts that belong in a commercial lines department, and identifies owners with multiple coverage needs who represent higher lifetime value. Producers receive a prepared conversation and can move directly to recommending and binding the right policy.

This product is suited to insurance businesses with a team ready to answer during defined hours, a clear view of the consumer they want, and the capacity to convert a live conversation. The acquisition objective is simple: put your team in front of business insurance consumers at the moment they are deciding.
targetConsumer: Sole proprietors, freelancers and owners of businesses with fewer than twenty employees, spanning consultants, cleaners, handymen, personal trainers, photographers, e-commerce sellers, salons and food vendors. The most valuable segments are newly formed businesses placing their first policy and established micro-businesses that need proof of coverage to win a contract.
consumerIntent: Typical intent signals include: searching for small business insurance or business liability insurance cost; recently registered an llc or obtained a business license; client, landlord or platform requesting a certificate of insurance; applying for a professional license that requires liability coverage or a bond.
howGenerated: Consumers are acquired through performance campaigns targeting searches such as "small business insurance" and "business liability insurance cost", plus social and comparison placements. Interested consumers speak with our qualification team before any transfer is attempted.
qualification: Qualification is configured to your appetite. Standard business insurance criteria include: operating or launching a business in a state the agency is licensed to write; business type and primary services or products confirmed; number of employees and approximate annual revenue stated; coverage need identified, such as general liability, professional liability, bop or workers' comp; timeline for needing coverage or a certificate captured; owner or decision maker interested in a quote today.
delivery: Once qualified, the consumer is bridged directly to your designated number or queue with a warm introduction. Delivery runs only during your operating hours with daily caps, and you can pause or adjust criteria at any time.

faq.q: Which types of businesses do these programs reach?
faq.a: Primarily micro and small businesses such as contractors, consultants, service providers, online sellers and home-based businesses. Targeting can be narrowed to the trades and professions you prefer.

faq.q: Can you screen out businesses outside our appetite?
faq.a: Yes. Excluded classes, employee counts and revenue thresholds can be built into the screening so that transfers match what your carriers will write.

faq.q: How urgent are these consumers typically?
faq.a: Many are responding to a contract, lease or licensing requirement and need coverage quickly, which favours agencies with same-day quote and bind capability.
